satellites.title: Making Bright the Bright Virtue
satellites.evidence: The opening of 大學 speaks of 明明德. This is ethical and textual illumination, not a physical optics claim.

satellites.title: Two Visible Components, Not a Theory of Origins
satellites.evidence: The received graph 明 visibly combines 日 and 月. This observation concerns graphic composition; it does not settle the disputed history of older forms.
satellites.caveat: Do not infer that the graph was originally invented by combining two celestial objects without early-form evidence.
